issues.issue: Nausea is presented as a single 12.7% rate but the citation 'Nausea 12.7 11.8' shows aprepitant vs standard; the 11.8% comparator is omitted, making the asymmetric presentation (comparator shown for asthenia/hiccups but not nausea/constipation) misleading.

Constipation cited quote is 'Constipation 10.3 12.2' — the AE rate is actually HIGHER in the standard group (12.2% vs 10.3%), so listing constipation as an aprepitant adverse experience is weakly supported.
